task.task_name: Triage a personal auto collision claim
task.task_description: You handle new auto insurance claims. A policyholder reports a two-car collision at an intersection and sends in their account of what happened, vehicle details, damage photos, the other driver's contact and insurance information, and a police report number. Some details might be missing or conflicting, and there may not be a repair estimate yet. Your task is to check the claim against the policy and available records, see whether there's enough information to move it forward, flag missing documents or possible coverage issues, and send it to the right claims team. Straightforward claims can go through the usual process. Claims involving injuries, conflicting accounts, signs of possible fraud, or complicated coverage questions need specialist attention. You're getting the claim ready for an adjuster, who will make the final coverage and liability decisions.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Review the reported collision and supporting records
operational_subtasks.description: Review the policyholder's account, vehicle and damage details, other driver's information, and available claim or police records; note material gaps or discrepancies in the reported facts.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: The task supplies the types of information to review; the estimate assumes this review occurs once per claim. Comparing several records and resolving what they do or do not establish is moderately involved, with effort varying according to record availability and discrepancies.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Check the policy and available coverage records
operational_subtasks.description: Compare the reported loss, involved vehicles, and loss details with the policy and available coverage records; identify potential coverage issues or questions without making the final coverage decision.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: The task explicitly requires checking the claim against the policy and available records; the estimate assumes one coverage review per claim. Effort reflects locating and interpreting relevant policy information, with added review when the reported facts raise a coverage question.

operational_subtasks.description: Check whether the information and documents needed to move the claim forward are present, including whether an absent repair estimate or other missing item is currently needed; identify and flag outstanding items.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: The task requires judging whether the file is sufficient and flagging missing documents; the estimate assumes one completeness assessment per claim. Most checks use the information already assembled, while determining the effect of a missing item requires additional review.

operational_subtasks.description: Evaluate the reviewed claim for reported injuries, conflicting accounts, signs of possible fraud, or complicated coverage questions that require specialist attention.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: The task specifies these referral criteria; the estimate assumes one screen per claim and that additional evaluation is needed in a minority of cases, approximately 10–25% as a modeling assumption. The base screen is a focused review, with extra effort when a potential trigger needs evaluation.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Route and hand off the claim
operational_subtasks.description: Send the claim to the usual claims process or the appropriate specialist team, communicating the relevant claim facts, potential coverage issues, missing items, and any referral condition for the adjuster's review.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: The task requires a team handoff for each claim, so the estimate assumes one routing and communication occurrence per parent output. Preparing the handoff is generally brief when the file is straightforward, with added coordination assumed for the approximately 10–25% of cases routed for specialist attention.

activities.trigger: The agent has completed its claim review and prepared a proposed disposition and handoff.
activities.expected_action: Check material findings and the proposed routing, amend or return the handoff if needed, and ensure it reaches the appropriate adjuster or team.

activities.description: Use human judgment when the agent identifies unresolved or ambiguous facts, material missing information, possible fraud indicators, injuries, conflicting accounts, or complicated coverage questions. activities.trigger: The agent flags an unresolved issue, an exception condition, or information that is insufficient to support routine handling.
activities.expected_action: Investigate or request needed information, document the resolution, and route the claim for specialist or adjuster review when warranted.
